jank_polished_flavor: Cleaned until the office got nervous. Fans will ask where the haunted energy went.
jank_sweet_spot_flavor: Enough wobble to feel alive; enough soul nobody calls it negligence.
jank_volatile_flavor: Seams visible, spell holds. Someone's already calling it intentional.
jank_broken_flavor: The machine is making sounds it did not make during certification, yet players remain emotionally available to it.
jank_default_flavor: The build survived the launch window by habit and bad wiring.
jank_card_unlock_note: Studio learned a new trick from this disaster.
jank_defining_game_note: A future critic will call this the moment the studio stopped imitating itself and became history.
roulette_intro_surprise_hit: Press phones overheating. Nobody expected the miracle build — least of all the studio.
roulette_intro_defining_game: Critics are arguing whether this is broken genius or genius broken on purpose. Either way, history just got patched.
roulette_intro_cult_classic: The score desk looks confused, but the faithful already know what happened here: the bugs were part of the testimony.
roulette_intro_legendary_jank: Reviewers are filing damage reports and recommendations in the same paragraph. This is how a mess becomes folklore.
roulette_intro_financial_catastrophe: Receipts are bad, morale is crooked, and the review circuit has arrived to explain your suffering in public.
roulette_intro_cult_disaster: Numbers catastrophic, fans inconsolable. Somewhere in the wreckage, something that almost mattered enormously.
roulette_intro_prestige_collapse: Respectable, maybe too respectable. You can almost hear the missing weirdness.
roulette_intro_rough_diamond: Nobody agrees on what this thing is, which is usually a sign that it might matter.
roulette_intro_high_score: The critics see promise, the fans see bruised sincerity, and the truth is buried somewhere in the patch notes.
roulette_intro_low_score: The room is quiet in the way only a hard launch can. The reviews will not be gentle.
roulette_intro_default: Nobody agrees on what this thing is, which is usually a sign that it might matter.
epilogue_surprise_hit: A sequel meeting has been scheduled before the team has finished panicking.
epilogue_defining_game: The build limps, sings, and refuses to be forgotten. The studio has finally made something only it could have made.
epilogue_cult_classic: The community will preserve every broken interaction like holy text and insist you never patch the good ones.
epilogue_legendary_jank: Somewhere, a speedrunner has already sworn loyalty to the exact crash pattern that almost killed the build.
epilogue_financial_catastrophe: The spreadsheets are ruinous, but the studio still has enough stubbornness to call tomorrow a strategy.
epilogue_cult_disaster: The studio will not recover quickly. But someone is already writing an essay about what it tried to do.
epilogue_prestige_collapse: Everything works, which is impressive, but the office can feel the soul pacing outside in the rain.
epilogue_rough_diamond: Not clean, not doomed. Still time for this to become somebody's favourite mistake.
epilogue_default: Not clean, not doomed. Still time for this to become somebody's favourite mistake.

ending_desc_defining_game: Defining Game: A janky masterpiece held together by conviction and duct tape.
ending_desc_cult_disaster: Cult Disaster: The studio poured everything into a build the market refused to understand.
ending_desc_rough_diamond: Rough Diamond: Mixed reviews, loyal fans, and enough runway for one more update.
ending_desc_legendary_jank: Legendary Jank: It barely runs, but speedrunners turn it into religion.
ending_desc_cult_classic: Cult Classic: Players preserve every bug in community-made museum builds.
ending_desc_surprise_hit: Surprise Hit: Publishers ask for a sequel before your patch notes are done.
ending_desc_financial_catastrophe: Financial Catastrophe: The studio survives on contract work and stubborn hope.
ending_desc_prestige_collapse: Prestige Collapse: It works. Every system works. Nobody can explain why it feels like a eulogy.
archetype_dialog_intro:
[b]What game is this studio making?[/b]

Your choice seeds the run. Cards that match your genre place cleanly. Off-genre cards add friction — and sometimes interesting jank.
